operations.expression:
safe_cholesky(
        innovation_cov + tf.constant(jitter, dtype=dtype) * tf.eye(obs_dim, dtype=dtype),
        "ukf_innovation",
    )

-(
            d_cost / cost_scale[None, :, None, None]
            - cost[None, ...] * d_cost_scale[:, :, None, None]
            / tf.square(cost_scale)[None, :, None, None]
        ) / eps_c

cost[None, ...] * d_cost_scale[:, :, None, None]
            / tf.square(cost_scale)[None, :, None, None]

tf.linalg.triangular_solve(
        injected_chol[None, ...],
        d_rhs
        - tf.linalg.matmul(
            d_injected_chol, solved[None, ...], transpose_a=True
        ),
        adjoint=True,
    )

jacobian[..., :, :, None]
        * column_scale_tangent[..., None, :, :]
        / tf.square(column_scale)[..., None, :, None]

(
        2.0
        * (
            standardized_tangent * row3[:, :, None]
            + standardized[:, :, None] * row3_tangent
        )
        + column3_tangent
        + 2.0
        * (
            standardized_tangent * row4[:, :, None]
            + standardized[:, :, None] * row4_tangent
        )
    ) / dimension_scale

tf.clip_by_value(
            target_co_skew_mask,
            tf.cast(0.0, source.dtype),
